Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and next steps while it’s fresh:

- Alex Johnson (FinPay) — Head of Payments / economic buyer
- Priya Sharma (FinPay) — Security lead
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — Account Exec

- Decision criteria: predictable latency (<200ms p50), cost per token targets, SOC2 + SSO/KMS support, and clear procurement terms.

- Security: Priya will lead security questionnaire; asked for SOC2 report and short security summary.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (draft attached: FinPay-MAP-draft-v1.pdf):
1) Aug 14 — Redwood to deliver MAP with pricing line items and integration notes (SSO/KMS)
2) Aug 17 — Technical deep-dive (Camila) to review SSO/KMS, throughput, and integration plan
3) Aug 19 — Procurement kickoff with Sam & Karen (FinPay)
4) Sep 2 — Contract signature target / pilot kickoff

Ask: Can you confirm the procurement/legal contacts (Sam & Karen) and whether the Aug 19 procurement kickoff works? If so, we’ll lock calendar and circulate an updated MAP with pricing by Aug 14.

I attached the MAP draft for review. Camila & Mateo are looped to help with the technical/security asks.

Quick tech notes and what we need to keep the timeline:

   - Target latency SLOs (you mentioned <200ms p50 during call)
